questions: Did the tremor begin suddenly?
Is the tremor present when your hands are completely at rest?
Is it worse when reaching, writing, eating, or holding objects?
Does it worsen with anxiety, stress, or lack of sleep?
Have you recently started or increased any prescription or nonprescription medication?
Do you use asthma inhalers, thyroid hormone, antidepressants, stimulants, or steroid medications?
Have you recently increased your intake of caffeine, energy drinks, nicotine, or other stimulants?
Have you recently stopped or reduced alcohol after drinking regularly?
Have you had palpitations or a persistently rapid heartbeat?
Have you been unusually sensitive to heat or sweating more than usual?
Have you lost weight without trying?
Have you had increased bowel movements or diarrhea?
Have you felt unusually nervous, restless, or unable to sleep?
Have you had episodes of sweating, shakiness, hunger, or confusion that improve after eating?
Do you have diabetes or take insulin or other glucose-lowering medication?
Does anyone in your family have a similar tremor?
Does the tremor improve temporarily after drinking alcohol?
Have you noticed stiffness, slowness of movement, balance problems, or changes in your walking?
Have you noticed weakness, numbness, impaired coordination, or changes in speech or vision?
Does the tremor involve your head or voice as well as your hands?
